market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Negotiations ongoing as of May 6 with US-Iran ceasefire since April 7; Trump told NY Post too soon for in-person talks. March 2026 Treasury lift on already-loaded Iranian oil at sea may not satisfy 'definitive agreement' standard. Iran reviewing latest US proposal. Unlikely a formal definitive deal in remaining ~25 days but not impossible.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Resolution language interpretation — whether existing temporary sanctions relief counts; speed of negotiations.
